# Technique catalogue

Every technique outside the clans (those are in [clans.md](clans.md)), E to S. Cast, cooldown are ticks (20 a second); chakra is the base cost before control, your own nature (x0.75) and mastery; power is base damage before level, pillar and nature scaling (0 for techniques that control, move or protect). The rules for each family are in [../COMBAT.md](../COMBAT.md).
